main_measure.name: mean signed unusual 5-bar move, combined top-10% minus best single top-10%
main_measure.threshold: Welch t >= 2 (with combined beating every single and slope t >= 2) confirms; Welch t <= -2 or slope t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: slope t of signed unusual move on abs(combined post_pipeline_value)

decided_by: Neither rule met: Welch t -1.01 vs best single s_reversal, combined beats all singles: False, slope t 0.65.
reading: Cells are rows 0,5,10,... of each window with a 5-bar return inside it; each group's top 10% is abs(last_history_value) at or above its pooled 90th percentile over measured cells, signed by that same component's raw value; the best single is the one with the highest mean signed unusual move; and since the minimum-count rule is stated, a group under 30 cases gives 'not observable'.
